title: Team load
intro: Each team's scheduled work against its capacity: the weeks its page marks as overloaded or over the WIP limit. Overload and WIP only warn — nothing moves.
truncated: The list shows its first {{count}} teams.
loadFailed: Could not load the teams' load

weeks.title: Weeks with a warning
weeks.intro: The weeks behind the two warning figures, team by team, oldest first: the load against the capacity and the most milestones in progress. A team's page shows all its weeks.
weeks.tableAria: Weeks with a warning, by team
weeks.truncated: Not every week is listed: the list stops after {{count}} weeks, team by team, so a later team may show fewer weeks or none.
